section.title: External sharing
section.description: Anyone with the link can read this conversation and ask questions without signing in. Their questions land in this conversation with a "Guest" badge.
section.permission: Guest permission: {{mode}} — follows this conversation's permission setting.
section.permissionAsk: When a guest's request needs a tool, you have to approve it in this browser before it continues.
section.permissionDanger: A single guest message can edit files and run commands without approval. Only share the link with people you trust.
section.publicUrlHint: The address people outside use to reach this server, such as a tunnel. Leave empty to use the current address ({{origin}}).
